exactness: Pure speed requires identical centroid mean/weight/kind, stats bits, wire fingerprint, all selected quantile and CDF bits at identical settings, plus no invariant failures. Wire hash is screening FNV1a64; retained changes require exact byte differential/full compatibility gates. ScalarCDF bits are independently included and must match batchCDF on each source. quality: Report empirical quantile rank interval, type7 value error, p50/IQR, midpointCDF max, exact integer mass/count/extrema, finite/positive centroids, monotonic outputs and wire query/byte roundtrip. No hidden logical storage increase. Adversarial weighted E01/E06 reported separately. No blanket epsilon.
limits: This screening is not the complete release gate.
No original arithmetic is benchmarked as a proxy for modern baseline.
Same-config comparison is not matched-memory equivalence; all logical storage increases are explicit.
Confirm uses fresh seeds, not untouched-for-all-future-experiments holdout; changes selected after seeing confirm must use another registered seed.
No claim about PyO3/Polars/JNI overhead from native timing.
Global pass/fail is not aggregated to hide individual regressing cells.
